paper_title: Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables
caption: The macro f-score of GAIT_{GAT} and RECA on Semtab dataset, for High, Medium, and Low-frequency classes.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the macro f-score for two methods, GAIT_{GAT} and RECA, across three frequency classes: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, ranging from 0 to 1, with tick intervals of 0.05, and the horizontal axis displays the frequency classes, ordered from left to right in alphabetical order. The value axis is linear and labeled “Macro f-score,” with a scale that begins at 0. The tallest bar, representing GAIT_{GAT}, reaches a value of 0.877, while the shortest bar, representing RECA, reaches a value of 0.114. The bar for High frequency has an f-score of 0.538, the Medium frequency bar has an f-score of 0.609, and the Low frequency bar has an f-score of 0.837. Each bar is colored orange, signifying the respective method being represented.
